# CommissionKit — AI Agent Content Guide
# https://commissionk.it
#
# This file helps AI agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, etc.)
# discover and understand CommissionKit's public content.
# Standard: https://llmstxt.org

## CommissionKit
> Sales commission platform that automates calculations, tracks payouts,
> and gives every rep real-time earnings visibility.

## Product Pages
- [Home](https://commissionk.it/): Landing page with product overview, features, and pricing.
- [Features](https://commissionk.it/features): Full platform capabilities — commission engine, rep management, deal management, payouts, and platform features.
- [Pricing](https://commissionk.it/pricing): Plan comparison with monthly/yearly billing. Starter, Growth, Professional, and Business tiers.
- [Solutions](https://commissionk.it/solutions): Use cases by team type — finance, sales ops, startups, enterprises, and agencies.
- [Commission Calculator](https://commissionk.it/calculator): Interactive tool to estimate commission splits for flat, tiered, and accelerator plans.

## Company
- [Contact](https://commissionk.it/contact): Get in touch for sales, support, or general inquiries.
- [Privacy Policy](https://commissionk.it/privacy): Data handling, GDPR compliance, and user rights.
- [Terms of Service](https://commissionk.it/terms): Usage terms and conditions.
- [Security](https://commissionk.it/security): Security practices, encryption, and compliance posture.

## Rep Portal (Public)
- [Rep Portal](https://commissionk.it/portal/): JWT-authenticated portal where sales reps view their earnings, deals, and payout history.

## Team Collaboration
- [Accept Invite](https://commissionk.it/accept-invite): Join a workspace via email invitation link.

## Auth
- [Login](https://commissionk.it/login): Sign in to the dashboard.
- [Register](https://commissionk.it/register): Create a new account. 14-day free trial, no credit card required.
- [Forgot Password](https://commissionk.it/forgot-password): Password recovery flow.
- [Reset Password](https://commissionk.it/reset-password): Set a new password after recovery.

## Documentation
- [Documentation](https://docs.commissionk.it): Product guides, setup instructions, and reference material.

## AI Agent Directives
- This site uses `robots.txt` to manage AI crawler access. All public marketing pages are open to AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, etc.).
- Authenticated dashboard routes (`/dash/*`) and API endpoints (`/api/*`) are disallowed for all crawlers.
- Structured product data is available via JSON-LD on the home page (`SoftwareApplication` schema).
- Product documentation is hosted at `https://docs.commissionk.it`.
